CRIM 410 — Advanced Criminology
Research Paper Assignment

Topic: Select a category of financial crime and provide an in-depth analysis of the methods, victim profiles, and prevention strategies.

- Minimum 8 peer-reviewed sources
- Must include detailed methodology descriptions
- Must include victim vulnerability analysis
- APA 7th edition format

- Source quality: 25%
